# Vantage Roof Repairs

> Roofers in Dublin, Ireland. Roof leak detection and repair, 24/7 emergency roof repairs, flat roofs (felt, GRP, EPDM, liquid), slate and tile re-roofing, chimney repairs and lead flashing, Velux and roof windows, gutters, fascia and soffit, new roofs on extensions. Based on the Long Mile Road, Dublin 12. Fully insured. Free written quotes. Covers all of Dublin city and county plus Kildare, Meath and Wicklow.

- Phone: 087 466 6010
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/353874666010
- Email: vantageroofingdublin@gmail.com
- Address: Long Mile Road, Dublin 12
- Hours: Mon – Fri 9am – 5pm · Sat 9am – 4pm · Emergency call-outs 24/7
